# Fixtures

`report-clean.json` is a healthy `chamber verify` report (no drift); `report-drift.json` has a `hash_mismatch` failure, a relocated pin, and a `goneFiles` entry; `report-legacy.json` is `report-drift.json` with `generatedAt` deleted, for testing reports written by older chamber versions. Regenerate with `CHAMBER_SRC=~/Projects/chamber node --experimental-strip-types scripts/regen-fixtures.mjs` (maintainer-only: needs Node ≥23.6 and a local chamber checkout). These are generated by real `chamber verify` code — never hand-edited; the gone.md pin verifying while the file is gone is Chamber KL 5, not a fixture bug.
